findings.passage: As someone who values both the Second Amendment and has personally experienced the impact of gun violence, I am proud to partner with Governor Gavin Newsom on the Right to Safety Resolution,
findings.note: Statement issued in her name as a state senator on the Right to Safety Resolution; quoted by Bearing Arms, a gun-rights outlet. Date is the article date; the statement itself may be earlier.

News article reports she introduced the Right to Safety Resolution (Senate Joint Resolution 7) in the California Senate; official bill page was blocked, so the introduction date and text are not confirmed.
